Fluid Fluid requirements are typically calculated at 1 mL/
kcal or 35 mL/kg (see Chapter 5). To treat ﬂ uid overload in HF, 
a ﬂ uid limitation of 1500 mL/day is the standard recommenda-
tion, with an upper level of 2000 mL. Again, adjustments will
need to be made based on renal and cardiac status in order to
prevent volume overload. Weighing the patient daily will allow 
the practitioner to monitor ﬂ uid status.
